evidence.observation: First of 30 failures from external 203.0.113.88, each against a different account, ten seconds apart: password spraying.
Successful RemoteInteractive (type 10) logon for m.lee from the SAME address at 14:07:20Z, minutes after the spray: the spray succeeded.
Second type 10 logon for m.lee from the same address at 14:11:20Z followed by a type 3 logon (evt-001141): the attacker is moving to the file server.

rationale: Distinct-account failures from one external source followed by a successful remote logon for one of the sprayed accounts from that source is the classic spray-to-access sequence. Treat the account as compromised and start incident handling immediately.
next_steps: Disable or reset m.lee and revoke active sessions
Isolate the RDS01 session and review activity after 14:07Z
Open an incident and record the timeline
